Review: Arithmetic and CheckedLowering model integers, addition, and a spawn seed; general constructors, patterns, calls, effects, collections, and full CoreIR preservation remain unproved. See lean_proof_gap_review_2026_09_25.md; existing exception expiry is unchanged.

Review: CheckedLowering proves admission or rejection of a spawn seed, not the full VM/JS/Wasm inference algorithm; broader contracts rely on executable Rust tests. See lean_proof_gap_review_2026_09_25.md; existing exception expiry is unchanged.

Review: SemanticChain and Concurrency prove small expression and list-mailbox models, not the AOT scheduler, heaps, continuations, or complete VM execution; Rust and Terlan tests are not a refinement proof. See lean_proof_gap_review_2026_09_25.md; existing exception expiry is unchanged.

Review: ShapeImplication proves closed-shape evidence properties; general pattern and operator coverage remains executable Terlan/Rust testing without corresponding Lean preservation theorems. See lean_proof_gap_review_2026_09_25.md; existing exception expiry is unchanged.

Review: WasmBridge proves a signature and resource-owner model, not a refinement from full CoreIR to emitted Wasm; complete lowering preservation remains unproved. See lean_proof_gap_review_2026_09_25.md; existing exception expiry is unchanged.

Review: NativeBoundary and the semantic kernels prove Lean models with runtime oracles; no inventoried Aeneas artifact connects the production Rust implementation to those models. See lean_proof_gap_review_2026_09_25.md; existing exception expiry is unchanged.
